column1: # Game profile of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.9.0 = v1114112). In bring-up
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys / ksys, NintendoWare G3d / Ui2d / Vfx / Atk, Havok), SDK 20.5.22, NVN; modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.

# RomFS is almost all Yaz0 (.s* extensions) and SARC (Pack/*.pack). Shaders: Shader/*.sbfsha (BNSH) and the gsys / ksys resource packs in Pack/Bootup_Graphics.pack, the terrain resource pack in TitleBG.pack, particle effects in Effect/*.sesetlist, layouts in .sblarc

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

column2: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

column1: # the virtual gamepad starts in the 3D layout (D-pad, right stick, L3 / R3): the right stick turns the camera
# The frame-interval controller (60 fps cuts in patches.py) and dynamic resolution read the GPU time between the frame's two timestamp reports: each report takes its segment's GPU start / end
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the host decides each frame's step in whole vsyncs and holds the frame that long (rewriter stubs at setWaitVsyncInterval and VFR::updateInterval,
# patches.py FRAME_STEP); 30 when 60 does not hold, game time = real time. DM_FPS_TARGET=30 (Documents/env.txt on the iPhone) saves power; 0 runs the game's own
# interval controller (with the 60 fps cuts, which also serve while the game's VFR override is set)
# only the merged 1.9.0 copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed
# Optional Mac cheats ported from the user's 1.8.2 DE0B6AC4EFC1DDA7 table.
# The 1.9.0 sites were checked by disassembly; offsets differ by code region.
# Fields: main build, option, offset, original word, replacement word.
# health: skip the current-heart store; stamina: read maximum instead of current;
# arrows: pass zero consumption. All options are off unless DM_CHEATS selects them.
# durability: the source cheat writes 60000 at the equipped-item break check.
# Reserve three zero words in text padding at +0x15a1d00, after the VFR veneer
# (+0x15a1c70..+0x15a1cab) and before RO (+0x15a2000). Preserve cmp/branch flags.
# Mac GPU uniform snapshots preserve draw values while avoiding pass splits.
# Mac resolution presets in the renderer's size setup, verified by disassembly.
# Fields: main build, offset, original instruction, 1280x720 word, 1920x1080 word.
# Update internal/output widths, output dimensions and crop together in both
# operation modes. Keep the game's reference widths and timing logic unchanged.

# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. Starts from 13 Sentinels' partition (4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region) until measured
# Real-time VFR hook on Mac (default 60; DM_FPS=90/120 raises the cap):
# build, compare site/word, explicit-override and ratio fields.
# Read-only bow state: build, mode global, PlayerInfo global, player field,
# charge global/field, state/lifecycle fields, active lifecycle/draw state/gameplay mode,
# bow link, link generation, owner generation/actor fields. Verified in pause,
# equipment loss, damage, empty-arrow, crouch/jump and scene-teardown captures.
# Gameplay mode, live player/equipment link, isGuard flag and shield durability.
